name: Gold
description: Coins carried at the start. Quantity comes from the background.

name: Rations
description: Trail food. Three uses.

name: Torch
description: Light source. Three uses.

name: Lantern
description: A steady light source that can be refilled with oil.

name: Oil Can
description: Oil for a lantern. Six uses.

name: Rope
description: A coil of rope, 25 feet long.

name: Chains
description: Iron chains, 10 feet long.

description: A ranged weapon that hurls stones. Damage d6.

description: A small blade. Damage d6.

name: Short Sword
description: A short blade. Damage d6.

name: Cane Sword

name: Hand Axe
description: A small axe. Damage d6.

name: Hammer
description: A heavy hammer. Damage d6.

name: Stake

name: Bonesaw
description: A surgical saw. Damage d6.

name: Needle-knife

name: Iron Dagger

name: Bow

description: A mechanical ranged weapon. Damage d8. Bulky.

description: A leather torso covering. Gives 1 Armor.

description: A leather jerkin said to bring luck. Gives 1 Armor.

description: Armor of overlapping plates in a fabric covering. Gives 1 Armor. Bulky.

name: Candle Helmet
description: A helmet with a candle set into it. Gives 1 Armor and dim light. Six uses.

name: Protective Gloves
description: Thick gloves that protect the hands. Petty.

name: Gloves
description: A pair of gloves. Petty.

name: Black Outfit
description: A dark outfit for moving unseen. Petty.

name: Stained Medical Finery
description: A surgeon's coat, stained with use. Petty.

name: Vestments of the Order
description: Ceremonial garments of a holy order. Petty.

name: Fancy Hat
description: An ostentatious hat. Petty.

name: Badge
description: A badge of office or a guild. Petty.

name: Heirloom Amulet
description: An old amulet that glows in the presence of magic. Petty.

name: Twine Bauble
description: A woven charm that can cast a Ward once per day. Petty.

name: Bandages
description: Cloth for dressing wounds. Three uses.

name: Leech

name: Healing Salve
description: A salve that restores 1d4 STR. One use.

name: Heartroot Salve
description: A salve made from heartroot. Restores 1d4 STR. One use.

name: Herbs Pouch
description: Dried herbs for remedies. Restores 1 STR. Three uses.

name: Soporific Darts

name: Lure
description: A bait used to attract animals.

name: Salt Pouch

name: Blessed Tinctures
description: Holy tinctures used against the unholy.

description: A scent or substance that drives off creatures. Three uses.

description: A heavy iron cooking pot.

name: Metal Pail
description: A metal bucket.

name: Ghillie Suit
description: Camouflage clothing for concealment in the wild.

description: Footwear that helps you walk on wet ground.

name: Tarp
description: A waterproof sheet for shelter.

name: Compass
description: A magnetic compass for finding direction.

name: Spyglass
description: A small telescope for viewing things at a distance.

name: Cart
description: A small wheeled cart. Adds 4 slots. Bulky when pulled.

name: Trick Playing Cards
description: A deck of cards used for sleight of hand.

name: Costume
description: A performer's costume.

name: Simple Instrument
description: A simple instrument such as pipes or a lute.

name: Lockpicks
description: Tools for opening locks.

name: Pincers
description: A pair of pincers for gripping and pulling.

name: Roll of Tin
description: A roll of thin tin sheet for repairs and tools.

name: Quill & Ink
description: Writing tools for documents and notes.

name: Blank Book
description: An empty book for notes and records.
